source_text: {Among the notable successes of the FEEC viewpoint has been the development of stable mixed finite element methods for the equations of elasticity. In this case, the relevant Hilbert complex is not the de Rham complex but rather some version of the \emph{elasticity complex}.}
translated_text: {FEEC 观点的显著成功之一, 是发展了弹性方程的稳定混合有限元方法. 此时相关的 Hilbert 复形不是 de Rham 复形, 而是某种版本的\emph{弹性复形}.}

source_text: {In fact, we shall prove a stronger result. Analogous to the space $\mathbb S$ of symmetric $n\times n$ tensor fields, let $\mathbb K$ denote the space of skew-symmetric $n\times n$ tensor fields. The dimensions are $\dim\mathbb S=\binom{n+1}2$, $\dim\mathbb K=\binom n2$, respectively. As usual, for any matrix $\tau\in\mathbb R^{n\times n}$, $\operatorname{skw}\tau\in\mathbb K$ denotes its skew-symmetric part.}
translated_text: {事实上, 将证明一个更强的结果. 类似于对称 $n\times n$ 张量场空间 $\mathbb S$, 以 $\mathbb K$ 表示反对称 $n\times n$ 张量场空间. 它们的维数分别为 $\dim\mathbb S=\binom{n+1}2$, $\dim\mathbb K=\binom n2$. 如常, 对任意矩阵 $\tau\in\mathbb R^{n\times n}$, $\operatorname{skw}\tau\in\mathbb K$ 表示其反对称部分.}

source_text:
{In three dimensions, the space $\mathbb K$ is itself three-dimensional, i.e., $\mathbb K\cong\mathbb R^3$. Thus we take $g$ to be a 3-vector field and impose the constraint $\operatorname{asym}\tau=g$, where now}
\[
\operatorname{asym}\tau=(\tau_{23}-\tau_{32},\tau_{31}-\tau_{13},\tau_{12}-\tau_{12}).
\]
{We also need the operator $S:\mathbb R^{3\times3}\to\mathbb R^{3\times3}$ given by}
\[
S\rho=\rho^T-(\operatorname{Tr}\rho)I,
\]
{where $\operatorname{Tr}$ denotes the matrix trace and $I$ the $3\times3$ identity matrix. This operator is invertible with}
\[
S^{-1}\mu=\mu^T-\frac12(\operatorname{Tr}\mu)I.
\]
{The relevant identity in three dimensions can now be expressed as commutativity of the diagram}
\[
\begin{tikzcd}[column sep=large,row sep=large]
H^1(\Omega;\mathbb R^{3\times3})\arrow[r,"\operatorname{curl}"]\arrow[d,"S"']&L^2(\Omega;\mathbb R^{3\times3})\arrow[d,"-\operatorname{asym}"]\\
H^1(\Omega;\mathbb R^{3\times3})\arrow[r,"\operatorname{div}"']&L^2(\Omega;\mathbb R^3)
\end{tikzcd}
\]
translated_text:
{在三维中, 空间 $\mathbb K$ 本身为三维, 即 $\mathbb K\cong\mathbb R^3$. 因而取 $g$ 为三维向量场, 并施加约束 $\operatorname{asym}\tau=g$, 其中现在}
\[
\operatorname{asym}\tau=(\tau_{23}-\tau_{32},\tau_{31}-\tau_{13},\tau_{12}-\tau_{12}).
\]
{还需要算子 $S:\mathbb R^{3\times3}\to\mathbb R^{3\times3}$, 定义为}
\[
S\rho=\rho^T-(\operatorname{Tr}\rho)I,
\]
{其中 $\operatorname{Tr}$ 表示矩阵的迹, $I$ 表示 $3\times3$ 单位矩阵. 此算子可逆, 且}
\[
S^{-1}\mu=\mu^T-\frac12(\operatorname{Tr}\mu)I.
\]
{现在, 三维中的相应恒等式可表达为下图的交换性}
\[
\begin{tikzcd}[column sep=large,row sep=large]
H^1(\Omega;\mathbb R^{3\times3})\arrow[r,"\operatorname{curl}"]\arrow[d,"S"']&L^2(\Omega;\mathbb R^{3\times3})\arrow[d,"-\operatorname{asym}"]\\
H^1(\Omega;\mathbb R^{3\times3})\arrow[r,"\operatorname{div}"']&L^2(\Omega;\mathbb R^3)
\end{tikzcd}
\]

source_text: {If we interchange the diagonal elements and reverse the signs of the off-diagonal elements of the Airy stress function \eqref{eq:maxwell-faraday}, we obtain the Hessian of $\phi$. This indicates that discretization of the two-dimensional elasticity complex is strongly related to $H^2$ scalar finite elements. This observation helped guide the way to the discovery of the first stable mixed finite elements for elasticity using polynomial trial functions in two dimensions. These were proposed in \BookCite{15} in 2002. Together with the classical Hermite quintic, or Argyris, finite element subspace of $H^2$, the stress and displacement elements form a finite element subcomplex of \eqref{eq:two-dimensional-elasticity-complex}. Since that work many alternatives and improvements have been proposed. The elements of \BookCite{15} were generalized to three dimensions, first in the lowest degree case \BookCite{1} and then for general degree \BookCite{8}. More efficient elements, applicable in any dimension, were developed in \BookCite{53} and \BookCite{54}. See the latter reference for a more extensive survey of the relevant literature.}
translated_text: {若交换 Airy 应力函数 \eqref{eq:maxwell-faraday} 的对角元素, 并将非对角元素变号, 就得到 $\phi$ 的 Hessian. 这表明二维弹性复形的离散化与 $H^2$ 标量有限元密切相关. 这一观察帮助引导了二维中首批使用多项式试函数的稳定弹性混合有限元的发现. 它们于 2002 年在 \BookCite{15} 中提出. 应力单元和位移单元与 $H^2$ 的经典 Hermite 五次, 或 Argyris, 有限元子空间一起, 构成 \eqref{eq:two-dimensional-elasticity-complex} 的有限元子复形. 此后提出了许多替代方案和改进. \BookCite{15} 的单元先在最低次情形 \BookCite{1}, 后在一般次数情形 \BookCite{8}, 被推广至三维. \BookCite{53} 和 \BookCite{54} 发展了适用于任意维数的更高效单元. 后一文献提供了相关文献的更广泛综述.}
